data.name: The Path of Life
data.detailed_description:
The Path of Life is a narrative-driven game where progression unfolds through walking. The story takes place in a fictional town called Chitown, which is currently affected by a natural phenomenon known as the “Acid Fog,” gradually altering its environment and order.

The player begins in the southern part of the town and travels on foot toward the north. Along the way, you will encounter various events and individuals, and occasionally find yourself drifting into unfamiliar dimensions. There is no strict guidance—exploration and observation shape the experience.

An unnamed character serves as the narrator, presenting Chitown through their own perspective and accompanying the player throughout the journey.

  • Discover photographs, letters, and roadside shops throughout your journey, gradually experiencing the diverse and shifting landscape of Chitown. Stylized dialogue encounters. Although the southern part of Chitown is largely abandoned, those you meet who can still “speak” each carry fragments of their own story.

  • Absurd, PPT-style storytelling that brings occasional moments of humor along the way.

  • Light platforming and combat elements integrated into the journey.

  • Original soundtrack composed by 谢有君 (xieyoujune) and other contributing composers, reflecting the local atmosphere of Chitown.

data.short_description: The Path of Life is a narrative exploration game centered around walking. Set in the fictional town of Chitown, which is gradually being consumed by a phenomenon known as the “Acid Fog,” players travel from south to north through a shifting landscape of fragmented events, encounters, and anomalies.
